name: PTSD Family Coach
one_liner: Free VA app for partners and family of someone with PTSD: learn about PTSD, look after your own stress, and encourage treatment.
best_for: Partners, parents and other family of someone living with PTSD
Military and veteran families who want free, private self-help
Supporters who want tools to manage their own stress and track how they are doing
Family members wondering how to encourage a loved one to get treatment
not_for: Anyone in crisis: call or text 988 (veterans and their families press 1)
People looking for couples or family therapy with a clinician
People who need help with their own PTSD symptoms (PTSD Coach is the VA app for that)
short_description: A free VA app for family members of someone with PTSD, with PTSD education, stress-management tools and stress tracking.
long_description: PTSD Family Coach was made by the VA's National Center for PTSD with the Department of Defense's National Center for Telehealth & Technology for partners and family of someone with PTSD. It explains PTSD and its effect on families, offers ideas for encouraging a loved one into treatment, and includes tools for managing your own stress with a way to track how you are doing over time. It is free and does not need an account; VA says it cannot access or share what you enter, and the information is only as secure as your phone. One pilot randomized trial (2023, 200 veteran family members) compared it with a psychoeducation app: only about half of participants used their app, and there were no differences between the apps on caregiver burden, stress, depression or anxiety. It is a self-help tool, not therapy.
patient_summary: PTSD Family Coach is for you if someone you love has PTSD. You can learn about PTSD, find ways to encourage treatment, and use short tools to handle your own stress and see how you're doing over time. It is free from the VA and needs no account.

pricing.notes: Free from the VA, with no subscriptions or in-app purchases.

privacy.notes: No account. VA says it cannot access, store or share what you enter, which stays on your phone; anonymous usage data is collected. Deleting the app removes your entries.

seo.title: PTSD Family Coach: Review & Pricing
seo.meta_description: PTSD Family Coach is a free app from the VA for partners and family members of someone living with PTSD.

faqs.q: How much does PTSD Family Coach cost?
faqs.a: Free. Prices were checked in October 2026 and can change, so confirm with PTSD Family Coach before you sign up.

faqs.q: Can PTSD Family Coach replace therapy or treatment?
faqs.a: No. PTSD Family Coach is a self-help tool that can support your wellbeing or work alongside therapy, but it doesn't diagnose or treat conditions. If you're in crisis, call or text 988 in the US.

faqs.q: Where can I use PTSD Family Coach?
faqs.a: PTSD Family Coach is available on iPhone and Android.

faqs.q: What does PTSD Family Coach include?
faqs.a: PTSD education for families; 24 stress-management tools; Stress tracking; Help encouraging treatment.

citation.title: The PTSD Family Coach App in Veteran Family Members: Pilot Randomized Controlled Trial

clinical_trials.outcome: About half of participants used their app. No differences between apps on caregiver burden, stress, depression or anxiety; using either app was linked to lower stress in a post hoc analysis.
clinical_trials.study_design: Pilot randomized controlled trial (active psychoeducation app control)

Managing your own stress as a supporter
Encouraging a loved one to seek treatment

availability.note: Free from the US Department of Veterans Affairs for anyone, on iPhone and Android.
